_comment: Manual fixes. Use item ids from data/items.json (e.g. youtube:XXXX, niconico:smXXXX). song = count this video as a song release, not_song = never count it, hide = drop the item from releases and from the video list (e.g. not Tobokegao's own work), same_video = uploads of one video under different titles, shown as one card, same_release = uploads of one release under different titles, grouped as one (the first id names it).
